newsitem.title: USA: Streicher says revises income statements.
newsitem.headline: Streicher says revises income statements.

text.p: Streicher Mobile Fueling Inc said Thursday it revised its condensed statements of operations for the three and nine month periods ended October 31, 1996 to increase both revenue and cost of sales by $1,818,000 from such amounts previously reported.

This revision was necessary to present the condensed statements of operations for the three and nine month periods ended October 31, 1996 on a basis consistent with the financial statements included in the registration statement filed in conjunction with the company's initial public offering, the company said.
This revision does not change previously reported gross profit or net income, the company said.
